prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Forest and Lemon: page #F8FCF9, text #16362B, accent #357346, secondary surface #F2E64B, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Use body 16px, heading 64px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
